description: PHP source code defining the CustomerActivity controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension. Contains methods for displaying customer activity reports, saving settings, and generating report data.

classes.name: CustomerActivity
classes.description: Controller class handling customer activity report functionalities in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer activity report form. Loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, and renders the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of customer activity report settings. Checks permissions, updates settings, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the customer activity report page, including report list and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer activity report list as JSON output.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches report data based on filters provided via GET parameters, formats the data, and returns as a string.
